rate_definitions.actual_call_start_rps: Client begins original HTTPX calls; pool waiting can follow.
rate_definitions.transport_header_start_rps: HTTPX transport begins sending request headers for original attempts.
rate_definitions.api_success_rps: Validated successful calls across the entire measured workload divided by duration.

method: Paired same-host ABBA sequence for baseline and S9, followed by two optimized S9 rounds. Each round used a fresh physical PostgreSQL 17.11 cluster and disposable objects on the same disk-backed filesystem. Each ran the original CI workload standalone, with an unchanged capacity gate and bench source.
scope: Rates are based on the 1,000 original overload requests. SQL, inclusive stages and service CPU cover the whole run, including warmup business operations and retries. Nested stage times overlap, and diagnostics were enabled for both versions. Two repetitions per revision describe this host; they give no cross-host confidence interval. The runner is a local Linux host, independent of the GitHub runners.

client_offering.criterion: Actual first call starts >=95% of frozen target; HTTPX waits still included
client_offering.scope: Client call-start rate only, not a claim of network wire rate or sustained capacity

rounds.all_status_scope: All attempts include expected 409 business conflicts. Overload counts use only label=overload.
